inputs.text: You know, this whole thing with tens of thousands marching through central London on Saturday as the supposed biggest protest against the far-right strikes me as another coordinated setup by the elites. It comes right after one of the largest far-right turnouts six months back and just weeks before those key local elections, all pulled together by hundreds of groups like trade unions, anti-racism outfits, and Muslim representative bodies under the Together Alliance banner. This is textbook elite coordination to whip up a fake crisis, slap the "extreme" label on any genuine resistance, and rig the elections by keeping people split and distracted from who's really pulling the strings behind it all.

subtopics: Groups organizing under the Together Alliance banner
Alleged electoral manipulation and social division
